boundaries.name: SHB_TO_PACKET
boundaries.error: Do not send without authenticated user/token

boundaries.name: PACKET_TO_TEST
boundaries.auth: Firebase Admin token verification and packet UID equality
boundaries.error: 401/403/400; no ML or write on rejection

boundaries.name: TEST_TO_DAY
boundaries.input: Three completed TEST observations, same UID, optional /qa_sessions

boundaries.name: DAY_TO_WEEK
boundaries.input: Seven completed DAY observations, same UID

boundaries.name: WEEK_TO_MONTH
boundaries.input: Four completed WEEK observations, same UID
boundaries.error: MONTH_NOT_ELIGIBLE for incomplete input; no zero fill

boundaries.name: REPORT_TO_HOME
boundaries.auth: Firebase Auth UID or explicitly authorized caretaker target

boundaries.name: REPORT_TO_NOTIFICATION
boundaries.error: No notification when report persistence fails
